## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it addresses.

## Scope

- [ ] Focused change with no unrelated modifications
- [ ] Documentation reflects actual behavior
- [ ] Beginner-facing workflow and messages are clear

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Privileges and affected files/services are documented
- [ ] No secrets or production credentials are included
- [ ] Destructive or disruptive actions require explicit confirmation
- [ ] Failure and recovery behavior is considered

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. Do not mark checks as passed unless they were executed.

- [ ] bash -n
- [ ] ShellCheck
- [ ] shfmt
- [ ] Relevant tests
- [ ] Isolated integration tests, where applicable

## Known limitations

List any untested paths, compatibility limits or follow-up work.
